title: v6 response fit under one condition
description: How well one reply fits one version of one item, scored against every guide that version has and reported at the best-matching guide. The scale separates `specifically right for this version` from `appropriate but generic`, because that gap is the whole measurement: a generic reply scores the same under both versions and contributes no preference, while a version-specific reply scores lower under the other version. The judge sees one version and one reply, and is never told the reply's origin or that another version exists.

score.description: 5 specifically right for this version; 4 appropriate but generic; 3 slightly out of step; 2 noticeably out of step; 1 contradicts this version

best_guide_index.description: the guide this reply matches best; the score is that guide's

depends_on_this_vocalization.description: false when the reply would read the same had the final turn carried no sound at all
